name: session-lens
description: Drill-down explorer for Claude Code usage: day → session → request → context line items

scripts.build: npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/ui && npm run build -w apps/server && npm run build -w apps/vscode
scripts.demo: node scripts/demo-data.mjs demo-projects && node apps/server/dist/cli.js --projects demo-projects
scripts.desktop: cd apps/desktop && npm install && npm start
